title: Build Grave Accord and polish rooms, records, and the first run
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord is a cooperative zombie bullet-hell game with seven classes,66 executable boss identities,five modes and six maps. This draft keeps the full feature branch separate from protected main while public polish continues.

New players get a gentle Solo preset, optional Tutorial, readable item names/prices, full home artwork, mode summaries and distinct difficulty icons. Room chat keeps its fight position and gets a separate menu area; C opens it, drafts/focus survive view changes, and upgrades use the available height. The obsolete rankings-unavailable message is removed. Pause labels and online behavior remain unchanged at the player's request; Solo pauses.

Team records replace the former online-board placeholder. Public authorities collect actual simulation counters, store immutable results/participant history in SQLite and provide mode/difficulty/peak-size/week filters and paged reads. Exact scores and competition ties are shared by the team. Departures retain credit, survival freezes before healing, the base result banks before the secret fight, and Endless compares its last-clear tuple. Writes retry without stopping play; hosts can finish Endless during a break. Solo/test runs and client-submitted scores cannot enter these boards. Desktop LAN has its own persistent records file.

Shared deployed global rankings/recovery, active mixed-progression/WAN/endurance/capacity and rendered/human/native-language/listening/device acceptance remain open.
